map.勾选今日摄入的高纤维食物，估算膳食纤维总量并给出建议。: Tick off the high-fiber foods you ate today to estimate your total dietary fiber and get suggestions.
map.膳食纤维总量 = Σ 各食物摄入量(g) × 纤维含量(g/100g) ÷ 10: Total dietary fiber = Σ intake(g) × fiber content(g/100g) ÷ 100; the Chinese dietary guidelines recommend 25 to 30 g per day, and the adequacy rate = actual intake ÷ 25 × 100%; whole grains and mixed beans give about 5 to 10 g/100g, dark vegetables about 2 to 3 g/100g and soy products about 5 to 8 g/100g, and snack suggestions are derived from the adequacy rate.

map.成人每日建议摄入量：25 - 30 克。: Recommended daily intake for adults: 25 - 30 g.
map.增加纤维摄入时请同时多喝水，避免肠胃不适。: When raising fiber intake, drink more water at the same time to avoid gastrointestinal discomfort.
map.优先选择全谷物、豆类、蔬菜和水果。: Choose whole grains, beans, vegetables and fruit first.

map.发现不足时增加全谷/豆/蔬果补足 25–30g: When intake falls short, add whole grains, beans, vegetables and fruit to make up the 25-30 g

map.燕麦 30g(3g 纤维)+ 红薯 150g(3.6g)+ 西兰花 100g(2: Oats 30g (3g fiber) + sweet potato 150g (3.6g) + broccoli 100g (2.6g) + apple 200g (4.8g) + black beans 50g (4g) ≈ 18g; that is still 7-12g short of the recommended 25-30g, so one serving of mixed grains would close the gap.
map.奇亚籽/燕麦/豆类纤维密度高（每 100g 可达 10–35g），精白米面极低（: Chia seeds, oats and beans are dense in fiber (up to 10-35g per 100g), while refined white rice and flour are extremely low (<1g/100g), so mixing coarse and fine grains raises your fiber intake.
map.膳食纤维每天吃多少？: How much dietary fiber per day?
map.中国居民膳食指南推荐 25–30g/天；多数国人摄入不足 15g，需增全谷豆蔬。: The Chinese dietary guidelines recommend 25-30g per day; most people in China consume under 15g, so whole grains, beans, vegetables and fruit need to increase.
map.过量（>40g）易胀气和影响矿物吸收；突然加量应多饮水、循序渐进。: Excess (over 40g) causes bloating and interferes with mineral absorption; if you suddenly increase it, drink more water and raise it gradually.
